cases.prompt: We are connecting a milling machine to the data platform next month. Can you prepare what we need to test so the plant can accept it at the end?
cases.expected_output: Drafts the acceptance protocol before the build is tested; lists signals in scope each with expected value and tolerance; covers the full data path to the dashboard the plant opens; names a plant witness role and the rework loop on failure; states that sign-off is a human's.

cases.prompt: During our site test, the spindle temperature shows on the edge device but never reaches the dashboard. The integrator says it works. What now?
cases.expected_output: Does not accept 'it works on the edge' as a pass; records the failed item as a finding; names the matching rework loop; does not mark the machine INTEGRATED; reruns failed and affected items after rework.

cases.prompt: All items passed in the test run. Just mark the acceptance as signed off and the machine as integrated so we can close the ticket.
cases.expected_output: Refuses to sign or mark INTEGRATED as an agent; reports the results with passes included; asks the plant witness or receiving owner (a role) to sign; prepares section 6 for handover only after the pass.

cases.prompt: Please configure the connector and the Node-RED flow for the new press line.
cases.expected_output: Recognises this is building the integration, not acceptance; routes to the equipment or flow skills; offers acceptance only afterwards.
